key_highlights: David Jones enters voluntary administration after failed landlord talks, leaving suppliers unpaid and retail REITs exposed ahead of Christmas.
ASX logged an $80b relief rally on US midterm election results as oil slumped, though ended the week mixed with bank weakness led by NAB.
RBA maintains a hawkish stance citing excess demand and sticky inflation, signaling unemployment must rise to tame price pressures.
Qantas flags a $1 billion fuel cost surge, forcing airfare increases and flight capacity reductions.
ASX data centre and gold explorer equities surged, contrasting with private tech restructuring including 1,200 job cuts at Canva.

sectors.trend: Severe retail solvency shock as 188-year-old department store David Jones enters administration following failed debt negotiations.
sectors.implications: Heightened credit risk for retail suppliers, inventory liquidation discounting, and negative sentiment across discretionary spending ahead of Christmas.

sectors.trend: Anchor tenant distress threatens retail centre revenues while borrowing capacity limits heighten residential price crash risks.
sectors.implications: Leasing income vulnerability and revaluation write-downs for major shopping centre landlords (SCG.AX, VCX.AX, GPT.AX).

sectors.trend: Sharp sell-off in NAB and rising mortgage credit headwinds amid reduced borrowing capacity and housing market downside forecasts.
sectors.implications: Net interest margin compression, slower credit growth, and rising provisioning risks across the major banks (NAB.AX, CBA.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX).

sectors.trend: Strong institutional appetite for critical digital infrastructure alongside headcount rationalisation in private tech.
sectors.implications: NextDC (NXT.AX) benefits from AI-driven data centre demand, while Canva's 1,200 layoffs reflect broad sector focus on cost control.

sectors.trend: Robust gold exploration updates and heavy capital raising menu alongside selective critical minerals and lithium exploration.
sectors.implications: Supportive liquidity for small-to-mid cap exploration plays (BPM.AX, CHN.AX, AGC.AX, KNI.AX, CRR.AX) offset by global macro scrutiny on bulk miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX).

sectors.trend: Slumping global crude oil prices offset by lingering aviation cost pressures, with Qantas facing $1bn higher fuel expenses.
sectors.implications: Fare increases and route cuts by Qantas (QAN.AX) to defend margins, testing consumer price elasticity.

key_themes: David Jones retail insolvency and landlord contagion
US midterm election outcome sparking broader market relief rally
RBA hawkish bias contrasting with household budget compression
Mortgage borrowing contraction and residential property correction risks
Resource sector capital raisings concentrated in gold and battery metals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Retail Counterparty Default & Rent Default Contagion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight retail property REITs; focus on grocery-anchored essential retail and prime industrial assets.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Prolonged RBA Policy Restraint & Credit Crunch
risk_assessment.mitigation: Limit exposure to highly leveraged real estate and cyclical lenders; maintain cash and high-grade short-term paper.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Aviation Fuel Cost Inflation & Margin Squeeze
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight airline transport operators exposed to volatile jet fuel crack spreads and soft domestic discretionary travel demand.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Tech Gig Economy Payroll Tax Liabilities
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review contractor-dependent technology and gig models following High Court ruling against Uber.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight digital infrastructure and cloud data centres
opportunities.rationale: Structural tailwinds from AI and enterprise cloud expansion insulate NextDC from consumer cycle headwinds.

opportunities.recommendation: Target high-grade junior gold explorers with funded drill programs
opportunities.rationale: Strong broker appetite and significant drilling results provide non-correlated equity upside.

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into defensive consumer staples over discretionary retailers
opportunities.rationale: Essential supermarket operators capture grocery wallet share as discretionary department stores lose footing.

defensive_moves.rationale: Immediate occupancy losses and renegotiation discounts post-David Jones administration impacting distribution yields.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to rate-sensitive major banks
defensive_moves.rationale: NAB dive highlights vulnerability to borrowing capacity erosion, margin compression, and housing market weakness.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Implement broad market hedges on ASX benchmark indices
defensive_moves.rationale: Midterms relief rally faces domestic headwinds from sticky CPI and RBA excess demand tightening.

market_outlook.short_term: The ASX 200 (^AXJO) is poised for rangebound consolidation near 8,200 as global post-midterms optimism is checked by domestic retail and banking headwinds.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month performance will hinge on RBA easing timing, housing market stability, and commodity demand support for major miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX).
